_comment: Tier-2 for kratos poisson#: confirms the ConvectionDiffusionApplication element-naming claims. LaplacianElement2D3N/3D4N + EulerianConvDiff2D3N/3D4N are valid Kratos element names accessible ONLY through the string-typed factory model_part.CreateNewElement(name, id, nodes, props) — they are NOT Python attributes on the CDA module. Wrong name 'ConvDiff2D3N' (no Eulerian prefix) is rejected with 'is not registered'. Discovered during this audit that KratosConvectionDiffusionApplication was missing from the .venv; installed via pip during probe. Verified empirically 2026-06-01 (Kratos 10.4.2). MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 hands the wrong-name probe the registered name LaplacianElement2D3N instead of the unregistered ConvDiff2D3N, so CreateNewElement succeeds. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: wrong_name_rejected=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/poisson_cda_element_string_factory && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
